This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across various political leanings. The chart is divided into ten segments and visually ordered by decreasing size. The largest segment, representing 36%, is colored red and labeled "Right bias." Following this is a blue segment labeled "Left bias," representing 28%. A segment colored orange, representing 22.5%, is labeled “Questionable source.” The remaining segments are smaller: a green segment representing 20% labeled “Left-center bias”; a purple segment representing 15% labeled "National Review"; a yellow segment representing 11% labeled "The Daily Caller;" a grey segment representing 8% labeled “Drudge Report;” a pink segment representing 8% labeled “NPR;" a teal segment representing 6% labeled "Vox;" a dark green segment representing about 5% labeled "Breitbart"; and a light-grey segment of approximately 3.5% labeled “Other.” The chart includes a legend identifying each color and the corresponding political leaning, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. No segments are visually emphasized such as being exploded or bolded.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Artikeln über verschiedene politische Lager und Medienorgane. Es besteht aus 11 Segmenten, die verschiedene Medienorgane und ideologische Positionen repräsentieren. Die Segmente sind wie folgt: "The Huffington Post" (rot, 6 %), "Drudge Report" (gelb, 7 %), "NPR" (hellblau, 8 %), "Vox" (grün, 6 %), "The Guardian" (dunkelblau, 5 %), "BBC" (hellgrau, 3 %), "RT" (orange, 3 %), "Daily Kos" (violett, 3 %), "ShareBlue" (hellgrün, 2 %), "The Hill" (braun, 2 %) und "Other" (grau, 11 %). Die Segmente sind in absteigender Größenreihenfolge angeordnet, wobei "Other" das größte Segment ist. Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die jedes Segment mit seinen zugehörigen Medienorganen kennzeichnet, aber keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente.
